title: When the Postcards Burns
author: Lena Coldharbour
blurb: Rafael Galloway, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
